changelog: A theme's outdated copies of Tracking's templates are reported in Tools → Site Health, as WooCommerce now reports its own, instead of in an admin notice. WooCommerce 11.2.1 dropped its outdated-templates notice for a Site Health test, and this one mirrors it: a "Performance" test that passes while every copy is up to date, and otherwise is a recommended improvement, "Your theme contains outdated Creative Shipment Tracking template overrides", listing each outdated copy with its version and linking to the section on WooCommerce → Status, which is unchanged. It reads the same cached check as 1.14.0.
1.14.0's warning on WooCommerce's screens and its Dismiss link. The update deletes every user's saved dismissal (ctracking_templates_notice_dismissed); uninstalling still deletes any left behind.
